about.title: About & disclaimer
about.d1: This is a clinical decision-support reference for qualified health professionals. It does not replace clinical judgment, local protocols or the product information.
about.d2: All content is a DRAFT pending human clinical validation (ICU, cardiology, hospital pharmacy). Local protocols and the treating clinician's judgment always prevail.
about.d3: Local or pharmacy standard concentrations override the example preparations. Always confirm ampoule strength (base vs salt), diluent, final volume and concentration before calculating.
about.d4: Worked examples (70 kg) are arithmetic references, not a prescription. Pediatric infusions are out of scope in this version.
about.d5: Double-check every pump setting independently and use a smart pump with the local drug library.
about.provenanceBody: Values were transcribed verbatim from the emergency-medicine reference package v1.35 (modules and evidence registry). Fields absent in the source are shown as “not stated”. Arithmetic is cross-checked against the package's calculator in automated tests.
about.privacyBody: No account, no server and no tracking. Everything runs in your browser and works offline; preferences are kept only in this device's storage. Do not enter patient identifiers.
